chosen_titles.rationale: Chapter 4 (LEGISLATURE) contains Act 472 of 1978, Michigan's Lobby Registration Act (MCL 4.411-4.431) — the state's lobbying-disclosure statute.

notes: MI 2010 vintage available on Justia. Michigan organizes its compiled laws by chapter, and lobbying disclosure lives entirely within Chapter 4 (Legislature) as Act 472 of 1978 — the same single-act regime structure used in MI 2015. No parallel executive-branch lobbying regime exists in Michigan; campaign-finance lives separately in Chapter 169 (out of scope). No support_title pick needed.
